_: What a QA run pretends to be running on. Each profile is the set of conditions that told a machine apart when a launch worked here and failed there; a run under one exercises those paths on whatever box it is on. `env` is exported to the game, `unset` is taken away from it, and `shims` are programs put first on the game's PATH from qa-shims/<machine>/ -- a real machine's answer, verbatim, where the difference is what a tool says rather than what is installed. Neither reaches the recorder or the pad. The rule: every difference only that machine showed is added to its profile, so the next run here finds it.
